edits.headline: Man arrested after fire at Hitler's Eagle's Nest retreat in Germany
edits.subheadline: Police arrested a 33-year-old German man on suspicion of arson, and no one was injured, the Associated Press reported.
editorialBody: A fire swept through the Eagle's Nest, the mountaintop retreat built for Adolf Hitler in the Bavarian Alps, the Associated Press reported. Police arrested a 33-year-old German man on suspicion of arson, and no one was injured.
Prosecutors said the man showed signs of mental illness and would be sent to a psychiatric facility, AP reported. They said they would also look into a possible political motive.
At Jamia Millia Islamia in Delhi, the university moved classes online after students and guards clashed during a protest, The Week reported. The students are demanding union elections.

In France, hundreds of thousands of people protested under heavy police security, Al Jazeera reported. The protests began in mid-September at a high school in Créteil over overcrowded classrooms and teacher shortages, and have widened to the cost of living.
Members of the RSS-affiliated Swadeshi Jagran Manch protested in Delhi against Starlink's launch in India, Outlook India reported.
In Pakistan, security sources said no security personnel were killed in an attack in Gwadar that the Baloch Liberation Front called "Operation Almas", the Pakistan Observer reported.
